changes.summary: The ritual is one of the most somber duties of a commander-in-chief.

changes.title: Trump to attend dignified transfer of fallen soldiers. And, Hegseth testifies on Iran
changes.summary: Trump will attend the dignified transfer of U.S. service members killed in the Middle East. And, Pete Hegseth is requesting billions from Congress to help with the rising cost of the war in Iran. (Image credit: Saul Loeb).

changes.title: Houthis in Yemen Edge Closer to Entering U.S.-Iran War
changes.summary: The Iran-backed Houthi militia in Yemen has declared a Red Sea blockade on Saudi Arabia, potentially opening a new front in the war rippling across the Middle East.

changes.title: Sen. Chris Murphy on the Iran war and Pete Hegseth's upcoming Senate testimony
changes.summary: NPR's Michel Martin speaks with Sen. Chris Murphy, D-Conn., about the escalating war in the Middle East and the testimony of Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth in front of a Senate panel on Tuesday.

changes.title: Nearly 100 U.S. service members injured in Iranian strikes this month
changes.summary: Almost 100 American service members have been injured in strikes on bases in the Middle East this month, U.S. officials said.

changes.title: How recent killings of U.S. soldiers could affect the war with Iran
changes.summary: President Trump reacted to the recent killings of U.S. soldiers in the Middle East with strong words on Monday, promising that Iran will pay "many times over." Mark Cancian, senior adviser at the Center for Strategic and International Studies, joins CBS News to break down what this means for the war and CBS News' Weiji.
